[abhi + gijjhati], 1. craves, is greedy (for, loc.) ; Sn 1039 (kāmesu nābhigijjheyya) quoted Peṭ 85, 21 ; Nidd I 241, 28 (cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpaṃ nābhigijjhati nābhihaṃsati na rāgaṃ janeti; ≠ S V 74, 6 : nābhijjhati); — part.pr. abhigijjhanta, mfn. , Nett 18, 12 (sekho ~anto); Pv-a 271, 1 (āhāre giddhā ~antā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee abhijighacchantā, prob. wr ); — neg. anabhigijjhanta, mfn. Nett 18, 14 ; — 2. envies ; S I 15, 21* (raṭṭhavanto pi khattiyā aññamaññābhigijjhanti; Spk I 52, 21 : aññamaññaṃ ~anti patthenti pihenti); — pp ( a ) abhigiddha , mfn. , craving, greedy for ; Ud-a 332, 10 (kāmesu ~-bhāvam eva pakāseti); ( b ) abhigijjhita , mfn. , craved, very much desired ; Thī-a 134, 30 (seṭṭhikumārehi pi ~ā paccāsīsitā, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce abhijjhitā); — see also abhijjhati.
